mapper.select: select id, owner_type as ownerType, owner_id as ownerId, leader_member_id as leaderId, status from play_team where id = #{teamId}
select count(1) from play_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 1
select topic_id from cms_activity where id = #{activityId}

select t.id from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id = t.id and m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.status = 1 where t.owner_type = #{ownerType} and t.owner_id = #{ownerId} and t.status in (0, 1, 2) order by t.id desc limit 1
select published_theme_runtime_config_json from cms_topic where id = #{topicId} and del_flag = 0
select count(1) from cms_topic_node where id = #{nodeId} and topic_id = #{topicId} and (status is null or status = 1)
mapper.sql: team_id as teamId, topic_id as topicId, activity_id as activityId, hints_total as hintsTotal, hints_used as hintsUsed, skips_total as skipsTotal, skips_used as skipsUsed, timer_limit_sec as timerLimitSec, timer_started_at as timerStartedAt, version, frozen_at as frozenAt
mapper.select: select s.config_snapshot_json from topic_route_session s join play_team_member m on m.member_id = s.member_id and m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.status = 1 where s.topic_id = #{topicId} and s.activity_id = #{activityId} and s.config_snapshot_json is not null order by (s.member_id = #{preferMemberId}) desc, s.id desc limit 1
select from play_team_resource_pool where team_id = #{teamId} for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into play_team_resource_pool(team_id, topic_id, activity_id, hints_total, skips_total, timer_limit_sec, frozen_at) values (#{teamId}, #{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{hintsTotal}, #{skipsTotal}, #{timerLimitSec}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.update:
update play_team_resource_pool set version = version + 1,
hints_used = hints_used + 1 where team_id = #{teamId} and hints_used < hints_total skips_used = skips_used + 1 where team_id = #{teamId} and skips_used < skips_total
update play_team_resource_pool set timer_started_at = current_timestamp(3), version = version + 1 where team_id = #{teamId} and timer_started_at is null and timer_limit_sec > 0
mapper.select: select member_id as memberId, request_id as requestId from play_team_resource_use where team_id = #{teamId} and kind = #{kind} and node_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.insert: insert into play_team_resource_use(team_id, kind, node_id, member_id, request_id, create_time) values (#{teamId}, #{kind}, #{nodeId}, #{memberId}, #{requestId}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select distinct p.node_id from player_node_progress p join play_team_member tm on tm.member_id = p.member_id and tm.team_id = #{teamId} and tm.status = 1 join cms_topic_node n on n.id = p.node_id and n.topic_id = #{topicId} and (n.status is null or n.status = 1) where p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.activity_id = #{activityId} and p.status = 1 and coalesce(p.del_flag, 0) = 0 order by p.node_id
mapper.insert: insert into play_team_pool_receipt(member_id, request_id, team_id, payload_fingerprint, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{requestId}, #{teamId}, #{fingerprint}, current_timestamp(3)) on duplicate key update member_id = member_id
mapper.select: select team_id as teamId, payload_fingerprint as fingerprint, response_json as response from play_team_pool_receipt where member_id = #{memberId} and request_id = #{requestId} for update
select team_id as teamId, payload_fingerprint as fingerprint, response_json as response from play_team_pool_receipt where member_id = #{memberId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update play_team_pool_receipt set response_json = #{response} where member_id = #{memberId} and request_id = #{requestId} and response_json is null
